extraction.summary_en: This filing records decisions of the sole shareholder (associée unique) of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES dated 29 June 2018: allocation of the year's profit to legal and other reserves, and replacement of the statutory auditor. It contains no capital increase/decrease, share transfer, or shareholder identity information beyond the generic 'Associée Unique' label; the capital figure of 400,000 euros appears only in the letterhead and is not treated as a snapshot per the rules.
